title: Git regime on any host
goal: Every clone, on any host, lands kb content on the integration main by direct push and code only through a code/<id> merge request; the pre-push hook refuses a code commit pushed straight to the integration main, and kbgit.py check-lanes reports one from the forge's commit association API; kbgit.py publish fast-forwards the public home from a green integration main without internal roots or private paths; branches from the public home reach integration through kbgit.py bridge; kb/_self/git.md, backlog.md and AGENTS.md state the regime.

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
Should sprint pushes also go to GitHub (the claude remote), besides GitLab origin?

notes: Run order 5 of 11; start after SP-aikswrrl “Route by verdict” closes; start gate approved by the operator; run backlog.py start when its turn comes; next: SP-rks3vx5g “Codebase maintainability proven”. GitHub (the public home) gets main only through kbgit.py publish (kb/_self/git.md, Public home); after this sprint, publish runs after every green integration main (the publish-when gate of ST-su4em5sl “kbgit.py publish fast-forwards the public home”). Its epic is EP-rumrqsu5 “Git regime: content and code lanes on any host, published to a public home”; it runs before SP-rks3vx5g so that ST-3i3dl6xg “kbgit.py is a CLI over kg_* modules” splits kbgit.py with the lane, publish and bridge code in it.
